cohort: The study enrolled 500 neonates for evaluation of Mongolian spots.
finding: The study found that 81.6% (408 out of 500) of neonates had Mongolian spots, with the sacrococcygeal area being the most common location.
mod_finding: N/A (The study noted that 54.1% of neonates with Mongolian spots were born via normal vaginal delivery, but did not present a finding comparing prevalence across different modes of birth.)
cross-section timing: within the first few weeks of life
birth_weight: More than 2.5 kg for 85.54% of neonates with Mongolian spots
gest_age: Full term for 89.71% of neonates with Mongolian spots
